identity: exact input bytes, case order, actual apps/source/runtime/artifact/Worker/provider/protocol/bundle hashes bound at phase level

replay_compatibility_only.warning: arm is transport compatibility only; all new semantic/accounting dispatch uses axis+method

schedule: case array order; F even zero-based case literal then typed, odd typed then literal; all other axes one method
parts: actual effective initial candidate library, exactly8. R equals the supplied per-case parts; G/F/E equals admitted stock. Completion candidates recorded separately in result/calls.
calls: closed localhost HTTP requests, responses including non200 and parse/transport failure, monotonic n, matching begin/end exactly once, timing. URL query method retained. External provider counts come from the fixed preload and journal, not localhost call counts.
result: unmodified actual API response (G/F), actual production runGoal result (R), actual UI data-goal result (E). Any scoring projection must bind back to these and actual factor logs.

G.known_decision_confidence: min actual intent/completeness for literal change coverage; ordinary intent confidence for intent controls; never fabricated1

F.typed_context: original utterance/initial graph/stock only; no literal candidates, gate outputs or oracle parts

E.target_scored: immediately after Goal before persistence operations
E.lifecycle: ordinary Apply then reload; compare original complete target raw log/head/records and actual painted frame
E.Undo: separate completed-ZIP keyless mechanics, same UI/session source; not each live unseen case

scoring: semantic scoring never promotes invalid source/protocol/journal/HTTP/paint admissibility to PASS; all fixed cases remain denominators

lifecycle_correction.superseded: R suggestion that Undo removes only last decision
lifecycle_correction.actual: unitsOf(draft).at(-1) removes the whole shared Goal group; no Redo
